## Core Commands

- `--baseline` — Runs every open gate once BEFORE the work and records which are red (evidence for --strict).
- `--check` — Executes the gate CHECK and, only if it passes, marks the gate [x]. Options: --strict, --force, --waive-red <reason>.
- `--evidence` — Shows the hash-chained evidence log and verifies it was not altered.
- `--export-templates` — Dumps embedded templates to standalone directory.
- `--force` — With --check: override integrity errors (logged in the evidence log).
- `--header` — Synthesizes Line 1 action and Line 2 state header.
- `--init` — Scaffolds .focusgate/GATES.md with domain anchors.
- `--lint` — Lints working memory bounds, anchors, and gates.
- `--next` — Prints next recommended action and state header.
- `--run` — Executes check commands for all runnable gates.
- `--status` — Displays state vector and gate status.
- `--strict` — With --check: require a prior red observation of this exact CHECK/EXPECT.
- `--waive-red` — With --check --strict: waive the red requirement with a recorded reason.
